messages.text: Drizzle, Raga Jazz, and a New Dwarf Planet Candidate
Expect a damp and cool November day with a chance of drizzle. Tonight, catch a unique blend of Indian ragas and jazz, or explore mathematical concepts in Ann Arbor.
Today will be drizzly with a high near 51°F and a low around 39°F, carrying a 43% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:14 AM and sunset at 5:21 PM, with a waning crescent moon 9.4% illuminated.

Experience "raga jazz" with pianist and composer Charu Suri at Cliff Bell's in Detroit at 7:30 PM. For a different kind of performance, the Go Comedy Improv Theater in Ferndale presents "Hip Prov" at 9:30 PM.
The Northern Taurids meteor shower is expected to peak on November 11.
Michigan Democrats have regained full control of the state government, securing a legislative trifecta. Abdul El-Sayed won the U.S. Senate seat, becoming the nation's first Muslim U.S. senator.
Tomorrow offers an overcast sky with a high near 52°F. The Southern Taurids meteor shower peaked earlier this week, but the Orionids are still active.
Published 2026-10-27: New dwarf planet candidate discovered by NSF–DOE Rubin Observatory.
Let the day's quiet discoveries shape your evening.
